title: EAP: Adding EAP-IKEv2 support
description:
This patch adds basic EAP-IKEv2 support.
This does not include EAP-IKEv2 fragmentation support.

notes.body: Look good, do you have a pcap to share ?

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5902/diffs?diff_id=312302032&start_sha=19a2ca033727a711f026a5a50106966b0a78270e#ba9dfaa312dd0a4a184369963ee705299af82832_2280_2280)

  • f2c22d1d - EAP: Adding EAP-IKEv2 support
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/5902/diffs?diff_id=312302032&start_sha=19a2ca033727a711f026a5a50106966b0a78270e)
the length is not good with call_dissector ? (and tvb ?)

The old code just marked all bytes and returned `return tvb_captured_length(tvb)`

The new code now marks only parsed bytes and returns the length:
```
+  proto_item_set_end(ti_root, tvb, offset);
+
+  return offset;
```

If I remove the `ti_root` I cannot call `proto_item_set_end`

Without the `proto_item_set_end`:

![image](/uploads/e8f3197f026456dbd755023e781acf5e/image.png)

![image](/uploads/074ca25a9538b070e056d982eadb3cfb/image.png)

The new field following the ISAKMP payload is shown as ISAKMP too.

To fix that problem, I changed to ti_root and added `proto_item_set_end`
may be make a specific commit for fix this (my typo i think...), we can backport...
